senses.gloss: प्रचकित a. Trembling, shuddering.

—1 An army in motion.
—2 A foraging army.

प्रचक्ष् €2 Ā.
—1 To say, speak, lay down; स्वजनाश्रु किलातिसंततं दहति प्रेतमिति
 प्रचक्षते R. 8. 86.
—2 To tell, relate.
—3 To consider, regard, deem.
—4 To name, call; योऽस्यात्मनः कारयिता तं क्षेत्रज्ञं प्रचक्षते

प्रचक्षस् m.
—1 The planet Jupiter.
—2 An epithet of Bṛhaspati.

प्रचण्ड a.
—1 Vehement, excessively violent, impetuous.
—2 Strong, powerful, fierce.
—3 Very hot, stifling (as heat).
—4 Furious, wrathful.
—5 Bold, confident.
—6 Terrible, terrific.
—7 Intolerable, unbearable.

प्रचण्ड + -आतपः fierce heat.
प्रचण्ड + -घोण a. large-nosed.

प्रचण्ड + -सूर्य a. having a hot or burning sun; प्रचण्डसूर्यः स्पृहणीयचन्द्रमाः Ṛs. 1. 1, 10.

प्रचण्डता, -त्वम्
—1 Violence, impetuosity.
—2 Boldness.

प्रचण्डता, -त्वम्
—1 Violence, impetuosity.
—2 Boldness.
प्रचपल a. Very unsteady or restless.
प्रच(चा)य See under प्रचि.
प्रच(चा)य See under प्रचि.

प्रचर् €1 P.
—1 To walk about, stalk forth.
—2 To go or issue forth, appear.
—3 To roam, wander over.
—4 To reach, arrive at.
—5 To spread, circulate, be prevalent or current.
—6 To prevail (as a custom).
—7 To undertake, set about (anything), proceed to work; चिकित्सकानां
 सर्वेषां मिथ्या प्रचरतां दमः Ms. 9. 284.
—8 To do, perform.
—9 To behave, act towards, treat.
—10 To be engaged in.
—11 To thrive, prosper. ━Caus.
—1 To cause or allow to roam.
—2 To turn out to graze.
—3 To make public.

—1 A road, path, way.
—2 A custom, usage.

—1 Going forth, ranging, walking about, wandering; शान्तमृगप्रचारम्
 (काननम्) Ku. 3. 42.
—2 Appearance, coming in, manifestation; U. 1; Mu. 1.
—3 Currency, prevalence, use, being used or applied; विलोक्य तैरप्यधुना
 प्रचारम् Trik.
—4 Conduct, behaviour; Mb. 12. 171. 15; cf. अध्यक्षप्रचारः (a title
 of the second book of Arthaśāstra.)
—5 Custom, usage.
—6 A playground, place of exercise.
—7 A pasture-ground, pasturage; गवां प्रचारेष्वासीनम् Mb. 1. 40. 17;
 ग्राम्येच्छया गोप्रचारो भूमी राजवशेन वा Y. 2. 166.
—8 A passage, path; योगक्षेमं प्रचारं च न विभाज्यं प्रचक्षते Ms. 9. 219.
—9 Proclamation in public; प्रचारे चापघोषयेत … Kau. A. 2. 8. 26.
—10 Movement, activity (संचार); प्रचारं स तु संगृह्य Rām. 7. 35. 49.

—1 Going forth, proceeding.
—2 Being current, circulating.
—3 Undertaking, beginning.
—4 Employing, using.
प्रचरणम् + .{@-णी@} A wooden-ladle.

प्रचरित p. p.
—1 Gone forth &c.
—2 Practised, followed, pursued (as a profession); यैः कर्मभिः प्रचरितैः
 शुश्रूष्यन्ते द्विजातयः Ms. 10. 100.
—3 Current, publicly known.

प्रचारित a.
—1 Allowed to wander.
—2 Made public or known, become current.
प्रचर्या Action, process.

प्रचारिन् a.
—1 Wandering.
—2 Showing itself, appearing.
—3 Proceeding with, behaving.

प्रचल् €1 P.
—1 To shake, move, tremble; समुद्रमपि संतरेत् प्रचलदूर्मिमालाकुलम् Bh. 2. 4.
—2 To go, walk, move on; set out, start off, depart.
—3 To start up, spring up.
—4 To be affected, disturbed or agitated.
—5 To prevail, be current.
—6 To swerve, deviate from (abl.). ━Caus. (चाल˚)
—1 To shake, stir up. (चल˚)
—2 To move, set in motion.
—3 To remove from.

प्रचल a.
—1 Trembling, shaking, tremulous; य उत्पलाक्षि प्रचलैर्विलोचनैस्तवाक्षिसादृश्यमिव
 प्रयुञ्जते Ku. 5. 35; Māl. 1. 38.
—2 Current, prevailing, customary.
—3 Going well or widely.
प्रचला f. A chamelion (Mar. सरडा).
प्रचल + .{@-लः@} A peacock; Nigh.
प्रचालः The neck of the Indian lute.

—1 Shaking, trembling.
—2 Retreat, flight.
—3 Circulation, currency.

प्रचालनम् Stirring, shaking, a stir; किं वृथार्थप्रचालनेन
 Pt. 5 ‘why discuss this matter in vain’.

प्रचलित (प्रचलत्) a.
—1 Shaken, moved, set in motion.
—2 Moving about; एतस्मिन् प्रचलाकिनां प्रचलतामुद्वेजिताः कूजितैः U. 2. 29.
—3 Wandering, roaming.
—4 Having set out or proceeded.
—5 Customary, recognized or received as authority.
—6 Current, prevalent.
—7 confused, bewildered.

प्रचलित (प्रचलत्) a.
—1 Shaken, moved, set in motion.
—2 Moving about; एतस्मिन् प्रचलाकिनां प्रचलतामुद्वेजिताः कूजितैः U. 2. 29.
—3 Wandering, roaming.
—4 Having set out or proceeded.
—5 Customary, recognized or received as authority.
—6 Current, prevalent.
—7 confused, bewildered.
प्रचलित (प्रचलत्) + .{@-तम्@} Going away, departure.

—1 Archery.
—2 A peacockʼs tail.
—3 A snake.
प्रचलाकः + .{@-का@} Ved. A violent shower of rain.
प्रचलाकिन् m. A peacock; U. 2. 29; प्रचलाकिकलापिनौ Trik.
प्रचलायित a. Rolling about, tossing.
प्रचलायित + .{@-तम्@} Nodding the head (while asleep in a sitting posture).

प्रचषालम् A particular ornament on a sacrificial post; चषालं
 प्रचषालं च यस्य यूपे हिरण्मये Mb. 7. 61. 6.

प्रचि €5 U.
—1 To collect, gather.
—2 To add to, increase, develop; to enhance, augment.
—3 To cut down; परेषामुत्तमाङ्गानि प्रचिन्वन्तमथेषुभिः Mb. 6. 14. 12. ━Pass.
—1 To grow, be developed; प्रचीयमानावयवा रराज सा R. 3. 7.
—2 To increase, multiply, thrive, prosper; अपि प्रचीयन्ते संव्यवहाराणां
 वृद्धिलाभाः Mu. 1.

प्राची The east; तनयमचिरात् प्राचीवार्कं प्रसूय च पावनम्

.━{@Comp.@}: प्राचीपतिः, प्राचीप्रमाणम्, प्राचीमूलम्

प्रच(चा)यः

—2 A multitude, quantity, collection, number; प्रसन्नः पुण्यानां प्रचय

—3 Growth, increase.
—4 Slight union.
—5 The neutral accentless tone (एकश्रुति).

प्रच(चा)यः
—1 Collecting, gathering (as flowers); P. III. 3. 40.

—1 Gathering (flowers &c.) in turn.
—2 A female who gathers.

प्रचित p. p.
—1 Gathered, collected, plucked.
—2 Amassed, accumulated.
—3 Covered, filled.
—4 Accentless (अनुदात्त).

प्रचेय a.
—1 To be gathered.
—2 To be increased.
—3 Spreading everywhere.

प्रचुद् €10 U.
—1 To impel, prompt, urge, incite; धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् Gāyatrīmantra;
 चापलाय प्रचोदितः R. 1. 9.
—2 To drive or urge on, push on.
—3 To excite, inspire, encourage, incite, stimulate.
—4 To enjoin, direct, prescribe.
—5 To request, ask.
—6 To fix, settle, determine.
—7 To proclaim, announce; परिवेषयेत प्रयतो गुणान् सर्वान् प्रचोदयन् Ms. 3. 228.

—1 Driving onward, urging, inciting.
—2 Instigating.
प्रचोदक a. Driving onward, urging, inciting.

—1 Driving onward, urging, inciting.
—2 Instigating, setting on.
—3 Ordering, enjoining, prescribing.
—4 A rule, precept, order, commandment.
—5 Saying.
—6 Sending, despatching.

प्रचोदित p. p.
—1 Urged, incited.
—2 Instigated.
—3 Directed, ordered, prescribed; चोदितो गुरुणा नित्यमप्रचोदित एव
 वा । कुर्यादध्ययने यत्नमाचार्यस्य हितेषु च ॥ Ms. 2. 191.
—4 Sent, despatched.
—5 Decreed, determined.
—6 Announced.
प्रचोदिन् a. Driving on, urging &c.

प्रचुर a.
—1 Much, ample, abundant, plentiful; नित्यव्यया प्रचुरनित्यधनागमा

—2 Great, large, extensive; प्रचुरपुरन्दरधनुः Gīt. 2.
—3 (At the end of comp.) Abounding in, filled or replete with.

—1 Abundance, plenty, copiousness.

प्रचेलकः A horse.

 पप्रच्छ K. 192; कुशलमबले पृच्छति त्वां वियुक्तः Me. 103; R. 1. 58.
—2 To ascertain, learn by inquiry.
—3 To seek, seek for.

 right shoulder and passed under the left arm, as at a Śrāddha.

प्राचीन + -आवीतिन्, -उपवीत a. wearing the sacred thread over the right
 shoulder and under the left arm; सव्ये प्राचीनआवीती निवीती कण्ठसज्जने Ms. 2. 63.

प्राचीन + -आवीतिन्, -उपवीत a. wearing the sacred thread over the right
 shoulder and under the left arm; सव्ये प्राचीनआवीती निवीती कण्ठसज्जने Ms. 2. 63.
प्राचीन + -कल्पः a former kalpa q. v.
प्राचीन + -गाथा an ancient story or tradition.
प्राचीन + -तिलकः the moon.
प्राचीन + -पनसः the Bilva tree.
प्राचीन + -बर्हिस् m. an epithet of Indra.
प्राचीन + -मतम् an ancient opinion, a belief sanctioned by antiquity.
प्राचीन + -मूल a. having roots turned eastward.

प्राच्य a. [प्राचि भवः यत्]
—1 Being or situated in front.
—2 Being or living in the east, eastern, easterly.
—3 Prior, preceding, previous.
—4 Ancient, old.

प्राच्य + .{@-च्याः@} (pl.)
—1 ‘The eastern country’, the country south or east of the river Sarasvatī.
—2 The people of this country.
.━{@Comp.@}: प्राच्यपदवृत्तिः, प्राच्यवृत्तिः

प्राच्य + -पदवृत्तिः a term applied to the rule according to which ए
 remains in particular cases unchanged before अ-भाषा the eastern dialect,
 language spoken in the east of India.
प्राच्य + -वृत्तिः a kind of metre.

प्राच्यक a.^1 Eastern, easterly.

प्राचार a. Contrary to ordinary institutes and observances.

—1 The teacher of a teacher.
—2 A former teacher.

—1 A mosquito.
—2 A female falcon.
प्राचीरम् An enclosure, fence, wall.

—1 Abundance, copiousness, plenty.
—2 Multitude.

—1 A patronymic of Manu.
—2 Of Dakṣa.
